grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, apples, raisins, lemon, cinnamon, pumpkin seeds and pure peanut butter are all plain whole foods a grandparent could have kept.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only two saucepans and a wooden spoon, and simple simmering.

works.reason: 160g oats to 1 litre water and four apples gently stewed with 100ml water give a sensible porridge and compote for four, with clear times and heat.

honest_times.reason: Coring and chopping four apples and juicing half a lemon fits in 10 minutes, and both pans finish within the 10 minute cook, which suits a quick breakfast.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing extra appears beyond water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm porridge built around stored apples suits a chilly March morning, and the apple compote is the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, practical British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, fruit, peanut butter and seeds make a filling, wholesome breakfast with no added sugar.
